planned_first_checkpoint: one calendar month or nearest selectable four-week return
planned_extended_checkpoint: season boundary if throughput and private save provenance permit
treatment: built-in holiday with delegated matches as a distinct observational regime
primary_observation: paired stored current ability change by verified player identity
tier_observation: candidate byte at CA+7, no tier setter
storage_estimate_basis: 12 monthly saves at baseline size plus changing file sizes, inventories and retention for recovery

destination could write a personal file
unbounded return, unknown blocking state or process failure
